entities.name: Fiber Optic Sensing Solutions Private Limited

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Automobile and Auto Components > Auto Components > Tyres & Rubber Products

operating_notes.text: Opened 15th exclusive Eurogrip signature store in Bahraich, Uttar Pradesh.
FY26 exceptional items included ₹18.81 Cr SIPCOT grant income, ₹5.36 Cr voluntary retirement scheme cost and ₹10.61 Cr labour-code past-service cost (standalone).
FY26 cash from operations ₹296.99 Cr against capex of ₹110.5 Cr; term loans repaid ₹83.14 Cr (standalone).
Single reportable segment: automotive tyres, tubes and flaps; group comprises four subsidiaries including Super Grip Corporation, USA.
2W plant at Vellaripatti, Madurai has existing capacity of approximately 210 to 235 lakh tyres per annum at about 80-85% utilisation.
Off-highway tyre plant at Vellaripatti, Madurai has existing capacity of approximately 75 to 85 metric tons per annum at about 75 to 80% utilisation.
₹220 Cr expansion to be funded by a combination of internal accruals and debt.
Approved ₹49.20 crore capex for 6-7% capacity addition across Madurai and Uttarakhand plants starting January 2027.

timeline.summary: On April 27, 2026, TVS Srichakra launched its 15th exclusive Eurogrip signature store in Bahraich, Uttar Pradesh.
On May 8, 2026, TVS Srichakra announced that its income tax demand for FY2017-18 was reduced from ₹29.47 Cr to ₹3.11 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹980.94 Cr (+19.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹29.13 Cr.
Shobhana Ramachandhran, Promoter, declared no new encumbrances on TVS Srichakra shares beyond prior disclosures for FY2026.
R Haresh, Managing Trustee of Sundaram Trust, declared no new encumbrances on TVS Srichakra shares under SEBI’s Takeover Regulations as of 01.04.2026.
R Dinesh, Promoter, declared no substantial share acquisition or encumbrance in TVS Srichakra Limited by 01.04.2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
R Haresh, Promoter, declared no new encumbrances on TVS Srichakra shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026, filed 01.04.2026.
TVS Srichakra approved ₹49.20 crore capex for a 6-7% capacity expansion across its Madurai and Uttarakhand plants starting January 2027.

watchlist.text: EBITDA margin holds above Q4FY26 level
